//: Typechecks the tests that assert type-level guarantees. tsconfig.json includes only src, because it drives the dist build, so nothing checked these before: a @ts-expect-error whose guarantee quietly stopped holding just became an unused directive that nobody ran.
//2: Scoped to a list rather than all of tests/ on purpose. The suite has ~119 pre-existing type errors from never having been checked -- worth clearing, but as its own job; a script that always fails is a script nobody runs.
//3: module/moduleResolution are overridden back to bundler: the published package is resolved by Node, so src is checked as nodenext, but tests are loaded by Vitest through Vite, which resolves as a bundler. Checking them as nodenext would model the wrong loader.
